title: S2 attempted-run inventory and caps ledger
objective: Make every top-level validation launch append a row to a terminal attempted-run inventory and charge CPU seconds, launches and artifact bytes against the contract caps, refusing to start once a cap is exhausted.
problem: Plan s3 Anchors: a terminal attempted-run inventory (every attempt, including failures and retries), with who supplied it and when. Plan s6: charge failures, retries, mutation children, analysis and confirmation attempts; stop at the first exhausted cap; keep partial/censored results. The inventory is append-only JSONL written with per-record flush; the ledger reads the caps from contract.json and only counts (no semantics).
non_goals: Does not decide what counts as a scientific attempt beyond 'every launch of the CI command or the mutation runner'; anything else is escalated
Python >= 3.8 standard library only; no package installation (MWO-0004 R2)
evidence_required: RED: a test that the 13th launch under a 12-launch cap is refused fails before implementation
GREEN: refusal works; a failed launch is still inventoried (cheat control: a crashing run leaves a row)
authority: operator directive 2026-10-03 s9, s11 (roles/Achilles/prompts/2026-10-03_rso_builder_cell/01_OPERATOR_DIRECTIVE_verbatim.md); decomposed by Palamedes under C-004-T000

resource_ceiling.note: Counts toward the slice caps fixed by C-004-OP1 (NEXT_ROUND_PLAN_v0.4 s6 proposal: 30 CPU-minutes total, 0 GPU, 0 cloud, 100 MB new artifacts, 12 top-level validation launches; mutation children count toward CPU). Stop at the first exhausted cap and keep partial results.
